# 00 — INDEX & READ-ME
### The codex is built in TWO LAYERS. This is the most important thing to understand.

> **VERSION:** v5 — Oct 2026. See *v5 — how this version was made* at the bottom. Lines this version overturned are kept in the 🚫 RETIRED list at the bottom, never silently deleted.
>
> **[NEW v5-wk2] v5-wk / v5-wk2 — 2026-10-31:** the late-October design rulings were folded in and then audited against the raw chat — see the changelog at the bottom. Several summary lines in *Core world premises* and *History & story* below predate that pass; the note at the top of each section lists which ones, and the files themselves are current.

> ## 🔵 WORLD / SYSTEM LAYER — rigid bedrock
> The physics, the magic-system, the forces, cosmology, the mythology, the method, the ability-mechanics. **This is the part that stays rigid.** 🔒 LAWs here are real and load-bearing. We hold these to the letter; they do NOT bend to serve story. This is the engine everything runs on.
>
> ## 🟡 STORY LAYER — fluid / work-in-progress
> Characters, names, plot, book structure, scenes, who-does-what. **Nothing here is fixed.** All names are placeholders (Jon, Derrek, the elf — ALL placeholders). Beats and roles move freely. **No 🔒 applies to story** — story is clay, by design, so new ideas can reshape it without breaking anything. The ONLY constraint on story is that it must not violate the WORLD bedrock. **Story-vs-story "conflicts" are not conflicts — they're just the story being unfinished.**
>
> **Why split this way:** the world must be rigorous (it's the science/magic that has to hold up). The story must be flexible (you never know when a new idea reshapes a character or plot, and if every line were locked, nothing could move). Build the world hard; let the story float on top.

## THE STABILITY TIER SYSTEM (applies to WORLD-layer content)
- 🔒 **LAW** — invariant. Never broken without explicit renegotiation. (WORLD layer only.) Only Patrick locks.
- ✅ **CONFIRMED, NOT LOCKED** — *(v5)* canon Patrick stated or accepted but never locked. Binding, but he may promote it to 🔒 or revise it. This is what most new v5 material carries.
- ⚖️ **FLEXIBLE** — adjustable with care (e.g. the rule-beast kit and Cascade — "they sound good and can always be adjusted later for scenes," jul08 t365).
- 🌊 **FLUID** — open clay, actively being shaped; includes ideas Claude proposed that Patrick hasn't ruled on.
- 🟡 **STORY** — provisional story content; movable by default; never law.
- 🚫 **RETIRED** — a tripwire; an idea we killed. Never reintroduce.
- *(⏳ = pending / not yet written.)*

## CORE WORLD PREMISES (the rigid spine, in one place)
> **[NEW v5-wk2] Superseded summary lines below (the files are current):** "No interface mechanism" and "REMNANT + SKILL = POWER" → the grip is mechanized as the appendage, the inner sense stays mysterious, three dials (Remnant, control, inner sense) (`02` Laws 1–2; wk W01–W06). "Inanimate matter never gains a soul" → matter can hold a soul; enchantment = a soul held in matter (`02` Law 0c; wk W12). "The Blight names only those who seek maximum dissolution" → keeper / consumer / Blight are titles at every level (`02` Law 13; wk W36). "Any user grown vast" becomes a god → humans only by time-fusion or theft (wk W31). Changelings "infiltrate" → largely monsters (wk W19). "A god asks for your devotion…" → a tendency, not a formula (wk W32; NP L15). Add: Remnant can never be burned or spent (wk W10).
> **[NEW v5-cc] Further superseded (pass 2026-11-16; the files are current):** the dials are **Remnant, Will, Skill**, sense and touch under Skill (`02` Law 2 🔒, cc R095); fatigue is the bill and **burnout** the body breaking (cc R096); Remnant is **capped by physical capacity**, with devices, grafted flesh and soul magic holding more (cc R097); enchantment = **Remnant held inside something** (cc R099); the bond is a **sensory organ** (cc R098); the keeper/consumer/Blight titles retire and **the Blight is a placeholder for the enemies of our reality** (cc R102); 0b holds inside a plane and **nesting by scale** is real between planes (cc R101); the lifespan ladder puts **dwarves below humans** (cc R093).
> **[NEW v5-cc] Superseded in fix 1 (2026-11-16):** "humans only by time-fusion or theft" → **any being of any size can become a god** with enough time and practice (cc R107); "time-fusion" → **one with time**, through the keeper's pact (cc R108); the puppeteer's "borrowed magic" is retired — **only time was given** (cc R109); held souls are **amplifiers, never batteries** (cc R112); the Tower is **mindless**, not "faintly feeling" (cc R111); "the Blight names only those who seek maximum dissolution" (below) is retired with the title set (cc R102); "every universe has its own pair" (History, below) is retired — breaks are local (cc R103).
- **The One = origin of CONSCIOUSNESS only.** The physical universe (matter, energy, the four forces) pre-exists it and is pure science, untouched. *(v5: "the One" is colloquial — what each world calls its own, "much like we say the sun," t192.)*
- **The Law of the Regress (v5).** Infinite and beginningless, the same story at every level: every plane of reality is a being that came apart so far — past the "forgetting horizon" (placeholder term) — that it became a new plane, and some part always clings together (t172). Our level: one level up a being came apart; the piece that let go completely is our One, the pieces that held on are the **Unified Ones**, and the other pieces that let go became the **sibling worlds** — siblings, not copies (t166–191). `03`.
- **The level above (v5).** A varied population. **The Blight** names only those who seek maximum dissolution (t176–178); the **Unified Ones** hold together and built the barrier that keeps it out. **Jon and Derrek's portal did not create the One — it opened that shield (the breach), and every reset rips it wider** (t184). The resets also swept the invaders back each loop. `02` Law 13, `03`.
- **Magic = inherited mastery.** The One *mastered* the universe (wielder, not author); a being's magic is a smaller expression of that mastery. No interface mechanism — the capacity is identity. **REMNANT + SKILL = POWER.** **SPIRIT = the name for active Remnant magic** (a being's faculty to consciously manipulate matter; having it is what separates a being from inert flesh). One undivided system; **the Body/Spirit "two kinds" split is retired.**
- **No steer-only; effort-gated; no physics audit.** Magic **may add energy** when the scene calls for it (steer-only retired; conservation no longer enforced). The only gates are **Remnant (how much) + skill (how well) + effort/fatigue (the bill)** — never a feasibility check. Rare second branch: **soul magic** (Spirit turned on another's Remnant — will-vs-will, self-risk). Remnant never transfers.
- **Forces & elements = pure descriptive FLAVOR, named after the act — never a power-class or a kind of person.** There are **no force/element "users," no types, no builds.** You watch the act, then call it gravity/fire/EM/weak. **Magic is EXPRESSION, not derivation:** build the person first; their magic follows. *(v5: "As with all our characters she is just a skilled user," t612.)*
- **All BEINGS descend from the One; matter is just physics.** Inanimate matter never gains a soul (t116).
- **AGING/LIFESPAN (bedrock):** every being = flesh + a piece of the One; more Remnant → more resistance to age (longer life) but **never immunity** — everything ages and dies. "God" = a larger chunk of Remnant in flesh — any user grown vast; no qualitative god/mortal divide. ✅ **Remnant itself is ageless; only flesh ages** (t678). Ladder: orcs < humans < dwarves < elves < **dragons (second-longest, t272)** < **giants (longest mortal)** < great gods (seem eternal). **NO true immortals among the aging.** True immortality is a separate MECHANISM (Jon, Derrek, rule-beasts). **No mortal can kill Derrek — another god can, and Jon is a god** (t370); whether the same holds for Jon is open. *(Elves & giants are ANCIENT MORTALS — not "near-immortal"; giants live MUCH longer than elves.)*
- **Soul theft belongs to no race (v5).** ✅ A **changeling is a crime, not a race** — a self-made soul thief of any people, a possessor, not a shapeshifter (t484, t680). Two roads: move your own soul into another body, or consume (t676). **Angels and demons are one kind of being**, soul mages of the changeling kind; a pact is a harvest run in reverse (t666, t674). Changeling, angel/demon and god are blurred regions on one continuum (t674).
- **Pacts (v5).** A pact grants **technique, never Remnant**, through a soul-magic tether that fades on the holder's side, never the patron's; the holder pays the usual effort/fatigue from their own limited Remnant (jul23 t107–108); taught abilities remain as the link fades. "A god asks for your devotion. A demon offers you a deal" (t548).
- **In-betweeners** are an ancient lineage that pre-dates the One, run the Rule instead of Remnant, and still obey physics. *(v5: the bounded space is the in-betweener's **Void**; **Chain** drags a victim into it, t128–130.)*
- **Design stance:** a **science-FLAVORED, SCENE-FIRST** magic story (*not* "mechanisms rigid, magnitudes bend," which is retired). Magic explains the *can* ("they are users"); physics is **light flavor** on the *what*, never an engine. **The science serves the cool; the instant it makes something less cool or adds homework, it loses.** Mechanism-policing is GONE; "we agreed no math" (t72). Rigor lives ONLY in internal consistency, never in matching reality's math. `14_PHYSICS_REFERENCE.md` is a non-binding flavor palette.

"Book" is a loose term (t314).

Jon and Derrek are the center of their wheel and still "one wheel of one car on one world" (t638).

They always have been" (t240); both are right for their own reasons (t724). **Derrek recast:** never supported the Blight (t180); he holds the world together against the breach; he is humanity's open, faceless **Emperor**, taken by force and charisma; Jon is the elves' god, taken by devotion (t550–552). Derrek cannot reset; only Jon can. **Jon's arc = a FALL** (warm young man → armor of coldness). `08`.
- **THEME = DUALITY** (strict: one subject holding two polar-opposite truths at once). **Thesis (Patrick, t466): "it doesn't matter in the grand scale, but everything matters to someone."** `09`.
- **The TOWER = the converged giant king.** On the dragons' betrayal day the giant king poured the last of his energy into becoming a giant stone tower (t86–87); Derrek built additions, not walls (t62); the portal fused it into all eras (t102). It is the center of all reality, and the window is at its center (t456). *(Who held it before Derrek — t102 vs t494 — is unreconciled; see NEEDS_PATRICK.)*

- **Three chats banked, in order of authority (later wins):** the chat of 2026-07-08, the chat of July 23, and the 783-turn physics chat (Oct 2026), each first turned into a turn-by-turn ledger (`claude/PHYSICS_CHAT_LEDGER.md` and the July ledgers).

- **Every change is marked inline** with its source turn: `[NEW v5]` / `[REV v5]` (physics chat), `[NEW v5-jul]` / `[REV v5-jul]` (July chats), `[RESTORED v5-verify]` (text an earlier pass had dropped), `[REV v5-xfile]` (cross-file alignment). Old wording is kept as "(was: …)"; overturned lines moved to each file's 🚫 RETIRED list.
- **Verified file by file** by a separate checker (locks, canon purity, nothing lost, retirements justified), then a final cross-file consistency pass. Anything that couldn't be settled from the sources was logged for Patrick, not decided.

### THE ONE 🔒
The origin of **consciousness** — once a singular conscious being that split to know itself, scattering into all minds. **The MASTER of the universe — master meaning *mastered*: wielder-in-chief whose will commands reality, the most powerful will *that we can see* (the regress means higher may exist beyond conception). NOT the author/origin of the universe** (physics pre-exists it; it lives within the laws); **NOT** "everything" (only *beings* descend from it).
- [NEW v5] **A colloquial name (t192):** "the One" is what people in our universe call *their* One, "much like we say the sun even tho its not really THE sun." Every sibling world calls its own One "the One."
- [NEW v5] **Where it came from (t166, t170–172):** one level up, a single being came apart; the piece that **let go completely** is the One ("He decohered into everything and now he cant pull back together," t166). The pieces that held on are the **Unified Ones**; the other pieces that let go are the other Ones (**sibling worlds**). See LAW OF THE REGRESS.
- [NEW v5] **Described LIKE a field (t8–9):** a soul is a resonance on the One's field, the way a quark is an excitation of its field — a **separate** field from the physical ones ("same grammar, different noun"). Consciousness vocabulary only; **NOT** a physical field and never a bridge between the domains (Constitution 0b/0c intact).

### REMNANT 🔒
**The chunk of the One that you ARE — IDENTITY, not fuel:** you can touch the world *because you ARE a remnant* of the One. A being's fragment = its consciousness = **how much reality it can grip at once** (capacity/aperture). [REV v5-cc] Innate, and **capped by the body's physical capacity**; devices and grafted flesh add capacity that holds more; soul magic crams more in, held by Will and the holder's own coherence (cc R097). (was: "Innate, fixed in the living, raisable only by harvesting (which fragments you).") **NOT fuel, NOT "mana," NOT spent per cast** (🚫 retired) — the act is billed only in bodily/mental **effort/fatigue**. [NEW v5-wk] **Remnant cannot be burned or spent** — "we cant burn remnant" (wk W10). **Soul = Remnant** (wk W07). Remnant extends the **APPENDAGE** and gives rise to the **INNER SENSE** (wk W01, W03; see TERMS ADDED IN v5-wk) [REV v5-cc] (the sense is now part of Skill, not a dial — cc R095). **NOT** skill; **NOT** a substance matter possesses. *(Remnant is what you ARE; **Spirit** is the name for actively using it — see below.)*
- [NEW v5-cc] ✅ **What it measures:** "It is a measure of how much of the one is held together" (Patrick, BANK 11-16) (cc R021).
- [NEW v5] ✅ **Remnant is ageless (t678):** "I think remnant is ageless." *(Confirmed, not locked — verify pass; matches Constitution 4a.)* The fragment does not age; flesh does. More Remnant only slows the flesh's decay (Constitution 4a).
- [NEW v5-jul] **Remnant is not transferable (jul23 t108, t114):** "remnant isn't transferable. They cant give their remnant they only give the knowledge or ability to use it"; "Remnant is no longer transferable." No siphons, no loans (see PACT). The one exception in canon is **wholesale absorption** of a weaker fragment by a stronger being (jul23 t116–t120; see SOUL MAGIC). [REV v5-cc] **Reconciled (cc R097):** your own fragment can't be given away, but extra Remnant can be held in added capacity (devices, grafted flesh) or crammed in by soul magic. (was: absorption as the only way to hold more.) *(🌊 The standing seam with reservoirs, drain chambers and the orc device's drain is unresolved — see `06`.)* [NEW v5-wk] Bearing on the seam: taking others' Remnant is **stealing their production** — [REV v5-wk2] [REV v5-cc] the mechanism is an amplifier — "I think its an amplifier only" (BANK 10-31); "drives their grip" retires (cc R132) (was: "the mechanism is 🌊 open — the thief driving their grip, or 'using an amplifier to touch a wider pool' (Patrick, chat t83: 'Im not sure')") (was: "the thief drives their grip" — Claude's t84 framing, never confirmed) (wk W11); Derrek's orc chips are named as stealing production (wk W51); [REV v5-cc] enchantment = Remnant held inside something (cc R099) (was: "enchantment = a soul held in matter (wk W12)"); held souls are amplifiers, never batteries (cc R112). How reservoirs and drain chambers read under these is still for Patrick.

### MAGIC 🔒
**Inherited mastery, science-flavored.** The One has *mastered* the universe (wielder-in-chief, not author); magic is a lesser being expressing a shard of that same mastery — reaching in and manipulating reality itself. [REV v5-wk] **The grip is mechanized — the APPENDAGE; the INNER SENSE stays mysterious** (wk W06). (was: "**No interface mechanism exists** (the capacity is identity; 'how?' bottoms out at 'you are a piece of the One').") Forces/energy/movement are *how we see* the act. In-world, **"magic" and "science" are the same word** — people don't distinguish them. [NEW v5-wk] Humans call magic "science" because dragons were humanity's first teachers (wk W63); faith, magic and science are one act under different names (wk W57; see RELIGION). **May add energy** when the scene calls for it (steer-only retired); the only cost is **effort/fatigue**. [REV v5-cc] Limits = **Remnant + Will + Skill, with fatigue the bill and burnout past it**, never a physics audit (cc R095, R096). (was: "Limits = **Remnant + skill + fatigue**, never a physics audit. [NEW v5-wk] The being's three dials are Remnant, control and the inner sense (wk W03; see THE THREE DIALS).") Only beings do it; matter cannot. [REV v5-wk] Matter itself does no magic; a soul held in matter (ENCHANTMENT) does (wk W12). (was: "Only beings do it; matter cannot." — stood unqualified.)
- [NEW v5-jul] **Machines can copy the look, never the act (jul08 t339–340):** "humans did the impossible and created technology that can manipulate the same forces we have as our magic system through entirely mechanical means" (e.g. an EM-field generator). The machine produces a **parallel effect described in the same words** — it is physics, not Spirit; it is not magic. A mind with no fragment (an ASI) does no magic: "Magic is implicitly stated as your conscious manipulating the world" (jul08 t339).

### SKILL / MASTERY 🔒
How *well* you grip and **blend** the forces and their expressions. Improves with training/time. The combinatorial fluency that, with Remnant, sets total power. **NOT** capacity. [NEW v5-wk] The rulings call this dial **control**; basic magic needs only control (wk W03, W04). [REV v5-cc] **Skill is your training, and covers sense and touch** — "Skill would cover sense and touch" (cc R095). (was: "**NOT** the inner sense, which is a separate dial (see THE THREE DIALS).")

### PHYSICS / THE FORCES 🔒
The material base reality — matter, energy, and the four fundamental forces (Strong, EM, Weak, Gravity) — **pre-existing, author-less, untouched.** Maps cleanly, no overlap. The bedrock the story rests on.

### RESPONSE / RESULTANT EFFECT 🔒
What the universe produces when the hand (Remnant) acts on it — a force, or pressure/spin/heat/torque/motion, etc. The *description of how the act looks*, not the power. All responses sit in one toolkit, gated by cost/difficulty; none is privileged. *(Retired: 'only the four forces are wieldable / energy-forms are mere results' — pressure, spin, etc. are directly manifestable responses too.)*

### FORCE 🔒 (now pure descriptive flavor)
One of the four real fundamental interactions (Strong, EM, Weak, Gravity), used as a **descriptive vocabulary for what magic looked like, applied after the fact.** **NOT** a power-class, tier, 'kind of mage,' or anything a being *is*. Nobody is a "force user." You watch someone collapse matter together → you *call* it gravity; reshape a thing → EM; warp what a thing *is* → weak. The label names the **act**, never the person. Blended freely with no permission check. The only structural residue: there are four real fundamental forces in the physics-flavor we nod to, and they never fuse into a fifth — but this gates no one.
- [NEW v5] **Reaffirmed (t136, t612):** the label "Strong-user"/"SF" is retired — "Hes just a master" (t136). "As with all our characters she is just a skilled user" (t612): no character is a "gravity type." Strong-flavored feats simply belong to the top of the scale.

### ELEMENT (fire/water/earth/air) 🔒
A **crude folk-name for an expression** — how a force-effect looks or feels (fire = an EM energy-release; "air" = moving particles you feel; etc.). **NOT** a real substance, base principle, or system-unit. The names are description; the forces are substance. One force wears many elemental faces.

### EXPRESSION 🔒
The felt/visible face of a force-effect, named in folk terms. The layer the cosmology and folk taxonomy live in (fire, water, earth, air, and physical-seeming "light/spirit/mind" effects). Rests on the force-bedrock.

### LIGHT / DARK 🔒 (variables, not cosmology)
Free descriptors — morality, aesthetics, expression-flavor — with **no cosmic doctrine.** (🚫 RETIRED: Reunion↔Separation poles; THE LIGHT as a cosmic being; THE DARK as the named remainder; the gathering. The old naming collision is moot — there is no cosmic Light/Dark to collide with.)

### LIGHT ↔ DARK (morality) ⚖️
A being's **goodness**, as a gradient. How you turn your power. NOT a power, NOT temperament.

### BODY (ability-type) 🚫 RETIRED
The Body/Spirit split is dissolved. There is no longer a "Body magic" category distinct from "Spirit magic." All magic is **Spirit** (active Remnant magic — see below); acting on matter is simply the common case. Do not reintroduce "Body" as an ability-type.

### SPIRIT 🔒 (redefined this session)
**The name for active Remnant magic** — a being's faculty for consciously manipulating matter (and, rarely, other consciousness). Spirit is *the system itself*: **having Spirit is what distinguishes a conscious being from inert flesh.** Flesh is just flesh; Spirit is what reaches out and acts. **NOT** "the consciousness-half of a two-part system" (that split is retired). Using your Remnant = doing Spirit magic. The rare branch where Spirit grips *another being's Remnant* (mind/soul) rather than matter is **soul magic** — different rules (will-vs-will, self-risk), `04_MAGIC_SUBSTRATE.md`.

### INWARD ↔ OUTWARD ⚖️ (demoted)
A **descriptive** note on whether an effect is turned on the self/gathered-in vs. spent on the world. **NOT** a system axis, **NOT** a personal trait, **NOT** part of the base. Use loosely if useful; never structurally.

### SOUL MAGIC 🔒 (added this session — the rare second branch)
**Spirit turned on another fragment of the One** (mind/memory/emotion/will/soul) instead of on matter. [REV v5-wk] Same Remnant and effort (was: "Same fuel (your own Remnant + effort)" — Remnant cannot be burned or spent, wk W10), completely different rules: no forces/elements — **will vs. will, coherence vs. coherence;** two-way and intimate (what you grip can grip you); the limiter is **self-risk** (overreach bleeds the other's nature into yours, fractures you), not fatigue. Rare. [REV v5-cc] Unifies soul-binding, harvesting and pact tethers; **the elven bond is no longer listed — it is a sensory organ, not soul magic** (cc R098). (was:) [REV v5-jul] Unifies soul-binding, harvesting, the elven bond (its gentle passive form and its weaponized authoritarian form alike), and pact tethers under one roof (jul23 t114, t132–134; propagation ordered jul23 t174). *(was: "…the elven bond, and demon-pact siphons" — the siphon is retired, see PACT.)* `04_MAGIC_SUBSTRATE.md`.
- [NEW v5] ✅ **Forbidden and scarcely known (t544); belongs to no race (t484):** *(confirmed, not locked — verify pass; matches Constitution 14)* "there's no reason any race cannot learn soul magic." **Tempting and taboo** — "Everyone knows you can steal and transfer souls" (t680). Holding a soul in place is **concentration** (see SOUL-BINDING).
- [NEW v5] **A pact is soul magic run in reverse (t666):** "Giving a pact would be the reverse of when they take a soul. Instead connecting to them and opening that flow."
- [NEW v5-jul] **Body theft (jul08 t329):** soul magic can override another being's Remnant and take over its body — the root of the changelings' "move body" road (t676).
- [NEW v5-jul] **Wholesale absorption ✅ (jul23 t116–t120):** slow siphoning is retired, full absorption is not. It is **gated by power, not race** — it "requires a being as strong as a changeling to even preform the act," and a god-scale being can do it "on larger scales… on many at once"; the absorbed being's "own coherence is lost to the swirl" of the greater Remnant (jul23 t118). A dragon or giant who uses spirit magic can do it too (jul23 t120), and so can Jon and Derrek (jul23 t119–120).
- 🌊 [NEW v5-cc] *The bond is now an organ, not a tether (cc R098); whether the July will-binding below survives, up close through the organ, is not ruled.* [NEW v5-jul] **The elven bond, weaponized (jul23 t132–134):** a strong elf can bind a weaker elf's will through the bond — "not as total," without destroying their coherence — and the bond serves as thought/disposition monitoring. *(🌊 v5-wk: how "monitoring" sits with W08 — the bond does NOT track individuals — is flagged for Patrick; see ELVEN BOND.)*
- [NEW v5-wk] **Sensing other beings' Remnant is a rare master-level skill** — "Some very talented masters have learned to sense other beings remnant. This is rare" (wk W07). On the page it is rare, felt rather than reported, and unreliable — never constant scanning (wk W09). [v5-verify-wk: 🌊 "felt rather than reported" and "unreliable" are Claude's specifics (chat t226), unconfirmed; rarity and anti-"video gamey" are Patrick's (t223, t225) — L35.] See INNER SENSE, ELVEN BOND. [REV v5-cc] ✅ **Sensing scales with the source:** "If your a powerful user you can sense remnant and magic in general… youd feel the tower like the sun"; "those mildly psychicly aware would feel ghosts" (BANK 11-16 [TOWER], [CAPITAL]). A huge source is felt by many; one person's Remnant only by rare masters (Law 3) (cc R129). (was: rarity read as covering every source.)
- [NEW v5-wk] **Stealing production** — taking others' Remnant; [REV v5-wk2] [REV v5-cc] the mechanism is an amplifier — "I think its an amplifier only" (BANK 10-31); "drives their grip" retires (cc R132) (was: "the mechanism is 🌊 open — the thief driving their grip, or 'using an amplifier to touch a wider pool' (Patrick, chat t83: 'Im not sure')") (was: "the thief drives their grip" — Claude's t84 framing, never confirmed) (wk W11). ### PACT 🔒 (umbrella — [REV v5-jul] reworked: the July pact rework, approved for banking phys t630)
[REV v5-jul] **Any deal with a powerful being for its way of doing magic.** *(was: "Any deal-with-a-being for a cut of its power, paid by a tithe.")* The single umbrella for all external-deal magic: demon pacts, **god blessings, blood rituals, divine-domain channeling, Blight-favor, Unified-One boons** — all are pacts at root, distinguished only by *patron* and *price*, not by being separate systems. *(🌊 Whether every patron on this list can sustain the link — blood rituals especially — was never ruled; jul23 t106/t137.)*

The holder pays effort/fatigue from **their own limited Remnant** (jul23 t108; Constitution Law 16). "A pact doesn't make you strong; it makes you unrepeatable" (jul23 t109, accepted). *(was: "Power flows to the mortal; something flows back (Remnant, years, memory, pieces of self). ### ENCHANTMENT 🔒 (umbrella — clarified this session; [REV v5-wk] redefined)
[REV v5-cc] **Enchantment is simply Remnant held inside something, in many uses and forms** — "Enchantment is simply holding remnant inside something. Many uses and forms" (cc R099). The imbues, the living metal, the chips and the Tower are "all the same thing… remnant being stored into an organic or inorganic form. Organics just hold it better" (BANK 11-16 [STORAGE · no mind]; cc R074 in part). Reservoirs, attunement objects and bound effects (below) are its uses and forms, not separate kinds; held Remnant adds capacity (cc R097). (was: "[REV v5-wk] **Enchantment = a soul held in matter** (wk W12)" as the definition.) Matter can hold Remnant because bodies are inanimate matter made animate; **body-like substrate holds best**. Matter itself does no magic; a held soul in matter does (wk W12; Constitution 0c). **A bound soul feels something: [REV v5-cc] only vague, general things, maybe some strangeness — "sensation comes from sensory organs" (BANK 11-02); dread is flavor, not the rule (cc R128) (was: "dread, without a brain to understand it")** (wk W13). **Objects hold souls without a holder's concentration; ghosts need a holder** (wk W14) [REV v5-wk2: 🌊 proposed, unconfirmed — Claude's proposal (chat t82); Patrick moved on and never addressed it]. (was: "**Power stored in matter** — a being's grip on reality impressed into an object and left to be drawn on later or to keep running on its own.") *🌊 The older description below — "reservoirs (stored charge)," "finite," "needs no Remnant to use" — predates W12 and sits against W10 (Remnant cannot be burned or spent); how an enchantment's power is drawn on and runs out is for Patrick.* Reservoirs (stored charge), attunement objects (skill amplifiers), bound effects (a working locked into matter). Finite, can't improvise, but needs no Remnant to *use* — the equalizer for low-Remnant/non-mage characters. Also a **learnable craft** (a discipline studied like potions/lore, not a kind of mage). Dwarves the candidate masters. `06_EXTERNAL_POWERS.md`.
- [NEW v5] Two enchantment-family devices have their own entries below: the dwarven **FOCUSING CHAMBER** and the **BOND-SPOOF CHIP**. Soul-binding is *not* enchantment: a binding must be held by concentration, while enchantment is fired and left (t504). [NEW v5-wk] W14 states the same line in new terms: objects hold souls without a holder's concentration; ghosts need a holder. [REV v5-wk2: W14 is 🌊 proposed, unconfirmed — Claude's proposal (chat t82), never addressed by Patrick]

### THE GRADIENT (awakening) 🔒

[NEW v5-wk] Basic magic needs only control; deeper levels need finer sense — a **cost gradient, not a gate** (wk W04).

## [NEW v5] TERMS ADDED IN v5
*(Physics-chat terms unless tagged v5-jul. Markers per the VERSION note at the top.)*

### LAW OF THE REGRESS 🔒 [NEW v5] (restates Constitution Law 11)
Every plane is a being that came apart: "all the way up the same story is playing… each stage is a being decohering so far it becomes an entirely new plane of reality and theres always the part who is clinging together still" (t172). The pieces that let go become the plane below (the Ones — our One and the sibling worlds); the pieces that hold on are **Unified Ones** (t166–172). [NEW v5-cc] Between planes the nesting is also by scale — real, "part of the magic", never explained; Constitution 0b holds inside a plane (cc R101). It is a shared law of selves — in-betweeners split by it too (t166) — **not** shared ancestry: in-betweeners are still not descended from the One. `03_COSMOLOGY`.

### FORGETTING HORIZON ✅ [NEW v5] (Claude's term — placeholder)
The point past which a decohering being's pieces can no longer remember the whole and so can never pull back together. Patrick's concept: "Go too far form too many and they can never remember who they were to return" (t164); "He decohered into everything and now he cant pull back together" (t166). The label is Claude's (t167). Applies to the One, to rule-beasts that split too far, and to every level of the regress — **not** to peoples' cultural memory.

### UNIFIED ONES 🔒 [NEW v5] (redefined with THE BLIGHT, t176)
The pieces of the level-above being that **held together**: "Unified one is those who as the name suggests hold together" (t176); "unified ones are the ones who wish to protect the shatter" (t174). Siblings of the One (t170). They built the barrier/bubble around our level that holds the Blight out; Jon and Derrek's portal breached it (t184). The being that caught Jon and Derrek is one of their kind at universe scale (see THE PUPPETEER). **NOT** the Blight. [NEW v5-wk] **The Unified Ones step up**; the puppeteer is the **keeper** who maintains the bubble around our universe (wk W35) [REV v5-cc] ("keeper" as a plain word, not a title — cc R102).
- [NEW v5-cc] ✅ **A Unified One that decoheres becomes an entire reality of its own;** one is strong enough to handle a kin's fragments, a whole sheet (Patrick, CU B2) (cc R072).

### THE BREACH ✅ [NEW v5]
The hole Jon and Derrek's portal tore in the Unified Ones' barrier: "They didnt create the one but their portal opened the protective shield the unified one had established. It actually explains what our earlier lines about the portals growing with each reset. Ripping them open" (t184). The portal did **not** create the One or the world (the retired portal-bootstrap stays retired). The rifts are where the higher level bleeds through (t186).

### THE PUPPETEER ✅ [NEW v5] (the patron; unnamed on purpose)
The being that answered Jon and Derrek's portal: "a being so great their entire universe of all its being was simply that being… a potential universe who never decohered it enslaved them. He isnt their patron so much as he is their puppeteer in a sense. It is his magic the two of them borrow. Neither exactly willing. So the being is unnamed intentionally to grand to be understood by people in our universe" (t196). [NEW v5-cc] 🚫 The "his magic the two of them borrow" clause is retired: their only given power was time (BANK 11-01; cc R109). Patrick calls it "the unified one" (t490; jul08 t359). Humanity worships it unknowingly through Derrek (t488). Its curse split knowledge from power: it "showed derrek the window and robbed jon his memories" (t728); it cursed Derrek's demand and, seeing Jon collapse in awe, tied Derrek to Jon's jumps (jul08 t359; see TETHER). 🌊 Its motive is open.
- [NEW v5-wk] **The puppeteer is the keeper** who maintains the bubble around our universe ("good" in quotes) — which is how he lends the time powers. At the breach, Jon and Derrek saw the keeper outside (wk W35). See KEEPER / CONSUMER / BLIGHT. [REV v5-cc] ("Keeper" is a plain word for him; the title set is retired — cc R102.)

### SIBLING WORLDS (parallel worlds) ✅ [NEW v5]
The other pieces of the level-above being that let go, each becoming its own One and its own universe: "surely the other many become their own ones? So connected to ours would mean other decohered one who who were born from the same source" (t190). **Siblings, not copies.** The portal opened every world connected to Jon and Derrek's (t186); [REV v5-cc] **breaks are local and vary by universe — many had no pair, some singles, some groups; the pull is theme only** (cc R103) (was: "each has its own pair of men opened at the same moment by the pull of reunion (t460–463), each its own Tower window (t458)"). The openings ripple outward from the first pair, "always infinity after" (t643–644). Jon and Derrek are the center of their own wheel, still "only being one wheel of one car on one world" (t638).

### UNIVERSE vs. POCKET DIMENSION ✅ [NEW v5]
**Universe** is reserved for the planes of the regress and the sibling worlds; [REV v5-wk] a pocket space (heaven, the dark prison — two of THE THREE WORLDS, whether made or found is debated, wk W27–W28) (was: "a made space (heaven, the dark prison)") is a **pocket dimension**: "we reserved universe so the infinite levels of the regress… these are 2 pocket dimensions" (t232). An in-betweener's carried bubble is its **Void**.

### VOID (in-betweener) ✅ [NEW v5]
The in-betweener's own pocket and the space around it: "The void is the space around the inbetweener. Because they arent moving through our dimension at all. They are moving their void to where they want it" (t130). "The void exists on top of the real world" (t430), so those who enter may not notice at first. It is where the Rule is played (t128). Outsiders can't breach it — "its an ambiguous moving zone attached to a in betweener" (t146). **NOT** the in-betweeners' realm in a geographic sense; it is the bubble each one carries. `06_EXTERNAL_POWERS`.

### CHAIN (in-betweener) ✅ [NEW v5]
"Chain the ability to bind" (t126); "chain drags the victim into void" (t130). A general in-betweener power, not one being's signature (t126). Distinct from the **Hold** (which forces something to stay mid-transition).

### CHAIN VOID (in-betweener) ✅ [NEW v5]
"Chain void would be the natural result of fusing the two. I like it being a general power tho" (t126). *(Inspired by an Idle Obelisk Miner drone combo, t124.)*

### THE MAZE (maze-land) ✅ [NEW v5]
A Rule laid on a region of real land: "Its literally a place where the rule beast laid his condition. Its just a chunk of land" (t154) — hills, rivers, fish and birds that were already there (t152). Doors you pass only by dematerializing and reforming; stretches so warped you must compress reality to cross; clans and empires living their whole lives in one segment (t150). Escape just crosses "from one seemingly similar field into another" (t154). Outsiders wander in and loop back (t156). The keeper lives at the center, "The biggest castle on the tallest hill" (t158) — "bound but not trapped" (t160). Home of the dwarves sold to it (see THE RETURNED).

### CONVERGENCE ✅ [NEW v5] ([REV v5-wk])
[REV v5-wk] **Convergence works on bodies** (wk W15). **The funerary version releases the soul.** **The emperor's version trapped the city's Remnant in the stone** — Patrick: "the emperor ... stoked their bodies as material"; "the remnant is all trapped inside the stone." He was a mix of souls and dissolved — too many souls at once (wk W15). **Remnant cannot be burned or spent** (wk W10), so the v5 "burnt to build" reading below is overturned. **The original Convergence was god-forging;** its lost secret was silencing the crowd into unison — **"soul mortar."** The greatest giant god is a million minds in unison, like parallel agents (wk W17). (was: "The giants' practice of burning a dead being's Remnant as the power for a will-imposed build" — the v5 text below is kept as the record; its burning/fuel lines are superseded.)
*v5 record:* The giants' practice of burning a dead being's Remnant as the power for a will-imposed build: "The living stone Mason uses the dead giants soul to fuel the build. He is fusing the fallen king into the walls his offspring will inhabit" (t36). Patrick named it: "I think we call it convergence. When soul and matter become one" (t54) — but it is **NOT** a union of soul and matter in the Constitution 0c sense: "You arent now the walls of a castle your power was the source used to grow the walls themselves" (t34). "Mostly its burnt to build"; some ambiguous residue of experience is left unresolved (t42). It began as a **sacred, consensual funerary rite** — "It was always consensual on death" (t46), the consent left ambiguous (t40) — with planning commissions ready for a king's funeral (t42); the dragon war **warped it into a tactic** (t46); it was later **monetized**, "the monetized practice of building giant architecture with stolen remnant" (t52). The technique works on any harvested Remnant; giants are its masters because it is their culture (t52). Source of giant halls and cathedral ships; the Tower is the giant king converging himself (t86). `07_BEINGS`.
- [NEW v5-cc] ✅ **Grown structures are Convergence:** "7 is convergence and thats how it works. The same way the tower was born. Just shaped into the modern ages towers" (Patrick, BANK 11-02 set 2) — far-future grown towers, buildings and hulls (cc R029).

### SOUL-BINDING ✅ [NEW v5]
Holding a soul in place by magic so it cannot disperse. It is **concentration** — "the cost is a constant effort to hold the magic still" (t504). The holder pays continuously; kill the holder and the binding lapses, [REV v5-cc] freeing what was held, its Remnant released (cc R096: Remnant can't be destroyed) (was: "freeing or destroying what was held") (t504). The vessel varies: "We happened to use his body this time. But we could lock him into an amulet like the son. Or armor like al" (t512) — holding, not undeath, is the mechanic.
- [NEW v5-wk] **Split by W14:** objects hold souls **without** a holder's concentration; ghosts **need** a holder (wk W14) [REV v5-wk2: 🌊 proposed, unconfirmed — Claude's proposal (chat t82); Patrick moved on and never addressed it]. 🌊 Which of the t512 vessels (own body, amulet, armor) count as "objects" and which as ghosts needing a holder is not stated — flagged.

### WARDEN-OBJECT ✅ [NEW v5] (placeholder term — Claude's label, t506–509; concept; mechanism deliberately loose)

"This one is slightly hand wavey but ghost magic isnt easy to quantify anyway" (t508). The object anchors a held soul; matter itself never gains one (Constitution 0c). ### BRAIN (vs. Remnant) ✅ [NEW v5-jul]

## [NEW v5-wk] TERMS ADDED IN v5-wk
*(From WEEK_RULINGS, the late-October design conversation; cites read (wk W##). Markers per the VERSION note at the top. No new 🔒.)*

### APPENDAGE / GRIP ✅ [NEW v5-wk]
**Remnant extends an appendage that grabs the universe.** Its length, size, shape and intensity scale with Remnant, skill and focus (wk W01). **This is the grip, now mechanized** — it replaces Law 1's old "no interface mechanism" (wk W06; Constitution 1). What the grip does, flavor-level and with no math: shaking particles = heat; pulling charges apart = lightning; crushing or ripping the nucleus = explosions; turning a quark = transmutation — **the hardest act**; a botched transmutation rips the nucleus; denting space = gravity (wk W02). Dragons stay four-legged: **the appendage is their hands**, and servants do the labor (wk W63). **NOT** the inner sense (a separate dial). [REV v5-cc] (Sense is now part of Skill; there is no separate sense dial — cc R095.)
- [NEW v5-cc] ✅ **Fine work tires it:** "their psychic hand is powerful but using magic to build or hold tools would be tiresome" (Patrick, BANK 11-16 [DRAGONS · no hands]) (cc R036).

### INNER SENSE ✅ [NEW v5-wk] [REV v5-cc]
[REV v5-cc] **No longer a dial. Sensing (sense and touch) is part of Skill; the perception text below is kept as that part of Skill** (cc R095). Patrick: "Will makes more sense to me. Skill would cover sense and touch." The third dial is now **WILL** (see TERMS ADDED IN v5-cc). (was, as written in v5-wk:) **An unexplained perception that comes from Remnant, separate from the appendage** — both trainable and innate (wk W03). Patrick: "you mostly feel with a second inner sense" (wk W05). "Feel" returns as skill: the inner sense is **a dial, not a gate** (wk W05; the old "feel-to-grip as a hard rule" stays retired). Basic magic needs only control; deeper levels need finer sense — **a cost gradient, not a gate** (wk W04). **It stays mysterious** — the grip is mechanized, the sense is not (wk W06). **Sensing other beings' Remnant** is a rare master-level skill (wk W07); on the page soul-sensing is rare, felt rather than reported, and unreliable — never "video gamey," no constant scanning or detecting (wk W09). **NOT** the elven bond (see ELVEN BOND).

### THE THREE DIALS ✅ [NEW v5-wk] [REV v5-cc]
[REV v5-cc] **Remnant (how much), Will (force of will: conviction, moral weight, wanting it), and Skill (your training, including sense and touch)** — three independent dials (Constitution 2 🔒; cc R095). Patrick's examples: "A poorly trained and timid giant can still produce nightmares to other races… because they are to scared to force it to obey"; "a small gnome who has the smallest potential remnant who has trained and has force of will still just cant quite beat a dragon in power" (BANK 11-16 [THREE AXES]). The "numb titan" (huge Remnant, poor sense) now reads as poor Skill. Effort/fatigue stays the bill; burnout is the body breaking past it (cc R096). (was: "**Remnant (strength), control (skill), and the inner sense** — three independent dials (wk W03; Constitution 2). Example: **the 'numb titan'** — huge Remnant, poor sense (wk W03). Effort/fatigue stays the bill (Constitution 2).")

> **MAJOR FOUNDATION RESET (earlier session).** The bedrock was re-laid: **the One = the origin of consciousness only; the physical universe and its four forces pre-exist the One and are pure science; magic is consciousness gripping that physics.** Many older laws were rewritten or retired to match. See the RETIRED list at the bottom.

> **STANCE SOFTENING (earlier session) — read this before the physics laws below.** The author pivoted from "mechanisms rigid / a physics engine" to **science-FLAVORED, scene-first fiction.** mechanism-policing is GONE. We do NOT audit which force achieves an effect, whether it's energetically feasible, mass-budgets, ignition conditions, or "this technically needs fusion not weak." **Scene first; light science-flavor after; the science serves the cool, and the instant science makes something LESS cool or adds homework, science loses.** Internal consistency (matching OUR OWN established rules) stays absolute; matching reality's math does not. `14_PHYSICS_REFERENCE.md` is a **non-binding flavor palette**, not a rulebook to check against.
>
> **⚠️ MAGIC REWORK (earlier session) — the biggest change; overrides older physics-law text where they conflict.** Three retirements: **(1) STEER-ONLY is dead** — magic may *add* energy whenever the scene calls for it; conservation is no longer enforced; the only cost is **effort/fatigue**. **(2) The BODY/SPIRIT split is dissolved** — there are no longer two kinds of magic. **SPIRIT is now simply the name for active Remnant magic** (a being's faculty to consciously manipulate matter; having it is what separates a being from flesh). **(3) Forces/elements are pure post-hoc FLAVOR** — no "users," no types, no clusters, no pathways, no reachability ladder; the label names the *act*, never the person. Magic is **expression, not derivation** (build the person first; magic flows from them). The full reworked system lives in `04_MAGIC_SUBSTRATE.md`. Laws 2, 5, 6, 18 below are updated; the rest of the physics-law detail (7b, 7c, 8) is now flavor. See the RETIRED list.

Rewritten this pass: the Regress (11), the Blight/Unified Ones (13), pacts and demons (16), the final-run law (19); amended: 0b (One-as-field guard-rail), 0c, 3, 4, 4a (Remnant is ageless; dragons in the lifespan gradient), 4b (Jon/Derrek killability; rule-beast forms), 7 (era labels), 7c, 14 (soul theft belongs to no race), 15, 17, 18, 18b, 20. ## TIER ZERO — THE BEDROCK (the deepest laws; everything else rests on these)

0a. 🔒 **A science-FLAVORED magic system — scene-first; the science serves the cool.** (SOFTENED in an earlier session, replacing "mechanisms rigid; magnitudes bend.") Magic explains the **CAN** ([REV v5-cc] "they can do it because they are users — Remnant, Will and Skill" (cc R095); was: "they can do it because they are users — Remnant + skill"); physics is a **light flavor** on the WHAT, never an engine. We build **cool scenes that look right**, then add *loose* science-flavor after — never starting from "what does physics allow." A real-science *nod* (fire burns, gravity crushes, lightning arcs, alchemy transmutes, entropy decays) is welcome **texture**; the *audit* (which force, feasibility, mass-budgets, ignition arithmetic, "this needs fusion not weak," photon pedantry) is **gone**. The rule of thumb: **the science serves the cool, and the instant science makes something LESS cool or adds homework, the science loses** (a being can supernova-reflect in a room outside time *because magic* — fine). A science nerd being unsatisfied with the exact physics is acceptable. **Rigor lives ONLY in internal consistency** — matching our OWN established rules (no contradicting prior canon; effects stay within what we've said the world does) — never in matching reality's math. *(RETIRED: "mechanisms are rigid and adjudicable"; the physics engine; matching reality's math as any standard.)* *(Re-confirmed v5: the author wants physics for his own intuition only — "not laws applied as requirements" — t0–5; "your doing math and we agreed no math" — t72. No numeric size charts, budgets, or stat tables.)*

0b. 🔒 **Two separate, unrelated domains, meeting at one point.**
   - **PHYSICS:** the material universe — matter, energy, and the four fundamental forces beneath it — **exists independently and pre-dates the One.** It has no metaphysical author; the forces separated from a primordial unity by ordinary symmetry-breaking. Physics is left rigorously untouched and obeyed to the letter.
   - **THE ONE / CONSCIOUSNESS:** the One is the origin of **experience/awareness**, not the universe. Its self-knowing split scattered it into all consciousness. The One is itself **subject to the forces** (consciousness arose *within* physics and obeys it).
   - **THE MEETING POINT is MAGIC** (Law 1). Physics and cosmology never otherwise touch, so neither corrupts the other.
   - [NEW v5-cc] **Premise clause — nesting between planes (cc R101).** This law holds **inside a plane**. Between planes, **nesting by scale is simply real** — "Its one of those things we just have to say is real. Thats part of the magic" (BANK 11-02) — and is never explained or audited. Both images are allowed as flavor: universes in every iota of Remnant, and our universe as "1 tiny particle in something much larger all the way up" (BANK 11-02). The One still authors no physics.
   - **The One-as-field reframe is a DESCRIPTION, never a bridge (v5; t8–9).** The One may be *described* like a quantum field — a soul as a resonance/excitation on the One's field, the way a quark is an excitation of the quark field — but it is a **separate field from every physical field** ("same grammar, different noun"). This is consciousness-domain vocabulary only: it does not make the One physical, does not make matter or forces flow from the One, and opens no causal channel between the domains other than magic (Law 1). Full treatment: `03_COSMOLOGY.md`. *(The wall was re-tested and stands — the author, t7: "we already tried the one created all matter and decided it just created soul.")*

0c. 🔒 **All BEINGS are descended from the One; matter is just physics.** ("Everything is the One" is RETIRED.) Consciousness is the One; inanimate matter is not — it is only physics, and needs no metaphysical account. A living being = a **physical body (physics) + a fragment of the One (consciousness/mind) inhabiting it.** Inanimate objects aren't alive because they hold no fragment of the One. [REV v5-wk] **— unless one is held in them: enchantment = a soul held in matter** (wk W12). [REV v5-cc] **Enchantment is simply Remnant held inside something, in many uses and forms** — "Enchantment is simply holding remnant inside something. Many uses and forms" (cc R099). (was: "enchantment = a soul held in matter" as the whole definition.) Matter can hold Remnant because bodies are inanimate matter made animate; body-like substrate holds best. **Matter itself does no magic; a held soul in matter does** — this is how W12 reconciles with this law (wk W12). (was: "Inanimate objects aren't alive because they hold no fragment of the One." — stood unqualified.) *(Re-confirmed v5: [REV v5-wk] **Convergence works on bodies** — the funerary version **releases** the soul; the emperor's version **trapped the city's Remnant in the stone** (wk W15). (was: "a giant's Convergence uses a dead soul as the power that grows the walls — 'your power was the source used to grow the walls themselves,' not a union of soul and stone — t34".) The author: "I dont like inanimate mater gaining a soul its weird" — t116 [REV v5-wk] — read with W12: a soul can be *held* in matter; the matter does no magic of its own (wk W12). The elementals' pooled-Remnant definition sits on this line and is parked, un-ratified — FLAGGED.)*
   - [NEW v5-wk] **A held soul feels something:** [REV v5-cc] only vague, general things, maybe some strangeness — "sensation comes from sensory organs" (BANK 11-02); dread is flavor, not the rule (cc R128) (was: "dread, without a brain to understand it") (wk W13).
   - [NEW v5-wk] **Objects hold souls without a holder's concentration; ghosts need a holder** (wk W14) [REV v5-wk2: 🌊 proposed, unconfirmed — Claude's proposal (chat t82); Patrick moved on and never addressed it]. Mechanics: `04_MAGIC_SUBSTRATE.md`, `06_EXTERNAL_POWERS.md`.
   - [NEW v5-jul] **The brain is body, not soul.** The brain is part of the physical body; a brain that has stopped working does not mean the fragment has gone — "this in our world wouldnt mean they lost their remnant just that their brain isnt functioning" (jul08 t331–332). The fragment leaves with death, not with the loss of an organ (Claude's reading, accepted by the author, jul08 t342–343). ## TIER ONE — MAGIC & REMNANT

A "weak god" still vastly exceeds mortals — just ranks low among gods. *(Re-confirmed v5, t668: "gods are what happens when ANY user becomes incredibly powerful" — a level of power, not a kind of being.)*

Say "lesser being" / "smaller being" instead. *(Older lines in this file still use "mortal" that way — e.g. Laws 4, 4b, 13 — and the author himself did at phys t370; left as written, flagged for the author.)*

[REV v5-cc] **Any being of any size, humans included, can become a god given enough time and practice** — "Any being of any size given enough time and enough practice can become a god" (BANK 11-01; cc R107). 4a. 🔒 **THE AGING / LIFESPAN LAW (bedrock).** Every being = **flesh + a piece of the One**, no exceptions. **"God" is a placeholder for a LARGER CHUNK OF REMNANT in flesh** — not a separate kind of being. **More Remnant → the flesh more strongly resists age, weather, injury, the elements → longer life** — but always **RESISTANCE, NEVER IMMUNITY.** Everything ages and dies eventually; the flesh, however powerfully sustained, grows old and ends over a long enough time. (This is *why* elders exist among the long-lived rather than an ageless uniform population — they age, just slowly.) **The lifespan gradient IS the Remnant gradient:** [REV v5-cc] orcs and dwarves (short; dwarves are low in Remnant and naturally short-lived, so they sit below humans — the ladder is amended as ruled: the dwarf rung moves; cc R093) < humans < elves < (was: "orcs (short) < humans < dwarves < elves <") **dragons (second-longest-lived; v5, t272)** < **GIANTS (longest of the mortal races)** < great gods (so long it *seems* eternal, but isn't). **There are NO TRUE IMMORTALS among the aging** — even the greatest gods merely *seem* eternal. *(This retires "near-immortal" for elves/giants — they are ANCIENT MORTALS; see 4b for the separate true-immortal category. Corrects the old "giants ~as long as elves" → giants live MUCH longer than elves, required by this law (largest Remnant). v5: giants' longevity rests on this law alone — "Giants dont have to be elemental to live for a long time its fine," t102; elementals are no longer giants, t78.)*
   - ✅ **REMNANT ITSELF IS AGELESS (v5, t678: "I think remnant is ageless").** *(Confirmed, not locked — verify pass: the author stated it but never locked it.)* Only flesh ages; Remnant slows the flesh's decay and never stops it. *(This retires the changeling "founder's clock" aging line — see `07_BEINGS.md`. How long a changeling who keeps moving into new flesh can last is open — FLAGGED.)*

I dont see why as a short lived race they wouldnt be trying desperately to extend their lives thru their craft." Low Remnant, naturally short-lived; hardy; they extend their lives through craft, tech and magic, which works on the flesh and does not change the gradient. 🌊 Where dwarves sit against orcs on the ladder is not ruled.

So a **god** (huge Remnant) is still **mortal** (ancient, but it dies), while a **rule-beast** is **immortal** — because immortality is mechanism, not scale. This is the *only* true immortality; everything else, however ancient, is finite (4a).

## TIER TWO — THE PHYSICS LAYER (forces are the base; elements are expressions)

5. 🔒 **The four FORCES are pure descriptive flavor — never a power-class or a kind of person.** (Strengthened in the magic rework.) Strong, EM, Weak, Gravity are a **vocabulary for describing what magic looked like, applied after the fact.** They are NOT a tier of magician, a class, an affinity-compass, zones, or anything a being *is*. **There are no "force users."** You watch the act, then name it (collapse matter → "gravity"; reshape → "EM"; warp identity → "weak"). The label names the act, never the person. Blended freely with no permission check. (The only structural residue: there are four real fundamental forces in the physics-flavor we nod to, and they never fuse into a fifth — but this gates no one.)

6. 🔒 **"Fire, water, earth, air" (and light/dark/spirit/mind as physical-seeming effects) are EXPRESSIONS, not reality** — crude, sensory folk-names for what force-effects look and feel like (an EM reaction igniting gas → "fire"; a gravity/strong shockwave shoving particles → a "punch of air"). The names are folk taxonomy; the forces are the substance. One force can wear many elemental "faces"; the mapping need not be one-to-one. **(RETIRED: elements as primary; forces as overlaps/combinations of elements; the element wheel; the coordinate/region grid; "Fire = energy" as a base principle.)**

7. 🔒 **The eras track the world's DISCOVERY of this** (ties the magic system to the ages of the world):
   - **The medieval era:** no concept of forces/physics; magic is named by sensation (fire/water/earth/air) and that *is* the worldview. The people of this age live in the expression-layer; forces operate invisibly, unnamed.
   - **The modern era (science-fantasy):** science arrives; the forces are named and explained as the base principle; "elements" revealed as their expressions.
   - **The far future:** forces fully understood and wielded directly at monumental scale.
   - **v5 — reading order (t454):** [REV v5-cc] **The order is now ruled (cc R089):** Book 1 = the far-future stalemate; Book 2 = about 5k years earlier, the near-future space "wild west" (Earth itself a slow, declining apocalypse); Book 3 = about 5k years before that, the late Darkest Age; Book 4 = the multiverse, undecided. Scenes still float until they find homes (wk W52). (was: "[REV v5-wk] **Book numbers and eras are placeholders; scenes float until they find homes; the old book orders are dead** (wk W52)", itself replacing "the books now open in the far future and work backward (far future → modern → the past; book order is story-layer, `09_STRUCTURE.md`).") The era facts above stand. [REV v5-cc] The old medieval-first reader-path is retired (see 🚫 RETIRED v5-cc; cc R089). (was: "The old reader-path built on a medieval-first order ('science-literate readers map each Book-1 element onto its real force and re-read Book 1 seeing the hidden physics') is open for the author — keep, reverse, or drop.")

7b. ⚖️ **The nuclear arts are the mythic top — by scale and prestige, NOT by audited mechanism.** (SOFTENED — the rigid "WEAK decays / STRONG builds / heavier-needs-fusion / iron-wall" division is DEMOTED to loose flavor.) Heavy/transformative feats — transmutation (turning matter into other elements), making gold, the most ruinous releases — are the **supreme, rare, prestigious arts of the mightiest** (gods, elders, dragons, giants), high on the *scale*, never a separate class. We do **NOT** police which nuclear process "really" achieves a feat, whether heavier elements "require fusion," critical-mass arithmetic, or ignition conditions. **Transmutation transmutes — full stop, no asterisk** (the rabbit-hole of "but heavier elements need fusion not weak" is exactly the homework we've dropped). *How* a user manages a great feat = [REV v5-cc] "they have the Remnant, Will and Skill — that is what being a mighty user means" (cc R095) (was: "they have the Remnant and skill — that is what being a mighty user means."). Steer-only still holds as *flavor* (the yield is the matter's own stored energy; the user supplies will, not the joules) — but it's a vibe, not an accounting. *(RETIRED: "Weak cannot build / Strong builds"; the iron wall as a rule; heavier-elements-need-fusion; the enablement "cheat" framed as a rigorous dodge; nuclear-process labeling of feats.)* *(v5, t136: "it requires being at the top of power to use strong force" — the top of the scale, never a category of person.)*
   - [NEW v5-wk] **What the grip does (flavor-level, no math):** shaking particles = heat; pulling charges apart = lightning; crushing or ripping the nucleus = explosions; turning a quark = transmutation — **the hardest act**; a botched transmutation rips the nucleus; denting space = gravity (wk W02).

7c. ⚖️ **Severed Rule-domains are cut off from the world's resources.** (SOFTENED — the "gravity needs a present mass-source / mass-budget" audit is DROPPED as homework; the severed-domain *effect* is kept because a scene relies on it.) Inside a severed Rule-domain (a Rule-0 space cut off from the universe), a steward is **cut off from everything the environment would normally supply** — no planet to draw on, no storm, no city's stored energy, none of the ambient world to lean on. You fight with **only what you are and what you brought in.** This is *flavor/atmosphere* (why Rule-duels are equalizing and lethal; why the master's sacrifice in the rule-beast's room uses only his own body and Remnant — `13_PROSE_AND_SCENES.md`), **not** an energy-accounting rule. Don't audit "does he have enough mass" — the point is simply: severed = alone with yourself. 🌊 *(The master harnessing the Tower inside the seal: NEEDS_PATRICK, Pass 2026-11 open calls, B-24 / A-43.)* *(RETIRED: gravity-requires-a-mass-reservoir as a policed mechanic; mass-budget arithmetic.)* *(v5: the "Strong-user" label is retired — "Hes just a master," t136; the sacrifice is now a black hole he feeds with himself, not a supernova, t432; the old "no gravity available" reasoning drops with it, t433.)*

8. 🚫 **RETIRED — "the EM/Weak line is absolute" (EM rearranges / Weak transmutes).** This was mechanism-policing, and it's the exact rule that broke the dragon breath (forcing "transmutation up to heavier elements technically needs fusion not weak → the breath needs two mechanisms"). GONE. Under the softened stance (0a, 7b): **transmutation transmutes, corrosion corrodes, fire burns — full stop, no nuclear-process labeling.** Effects are *cool things wielded*, not categorized by which force "really" does them. Dragons wield varied breaths (fire, lightning, corrosion, rot, freeze, alchemy/transmutation, poison) **without** any force-label or feasibility audit (`07_BEINGS.md`).

9. 🔒 **Combination is a SPACE, wielded — never a new force.** A practitioner may run: one force; multiple forces **side by side** (each doing its own thing — NOT a merger); and forces layered with their expressions at once. **A force is only ever a real fundamental force — they never fuse into a fifth thing.** (Max-power example: hold matter in a black hole [Gravity] while igniting a star at its core [Strong-forced fusion] — two real forces wielded together.) **Mastery = combinatorial fluency** (how much of this space you can access and weave), distinct from raw Remnant.

10. 🔒 **No temperament-gating of access.** Personality does NOT make any force/expression easier or harder to *reach*. It shapes only the **learning path and the expression**: a patient person may learn from a master and express control; a hot-head may learn from reckless doing and express the same force as quakes and impacts — same force, different human, neither blocked. (Disposition colors *how* you learn/wield, never *what* you can — real-life-like.) **(RETIRED: temperament/affinity determining or rooting an element; disposition setting learning difficulty as a rule.)**

## TIER FOUR — EXTERNAL SYSTEMS & THE PRINCIPALS

15. 🔒 **In-betweeners / threshold-beings are an ANCIENT LINEAGE that PRE-DATES the One — NOT descended from it.** They are as old as the One (or so old they have collectively forgotten coming from any higher source), and live in their own **bubble between the worlds**, structurally like how our world sits in its own pocket of the regress. Because they are not the One's consciousness, they do not use Remnant — they run **an older operating system, the Rule.** They still **obey physics** (the material universe is the shared substrate). The Rule: a binding condition on a bounded space that traps everyone inside (themselves included), releasing only when its condition is met. **Cascade** sets the condition to its lethal terminus at the cost of self-erasure. (A chase inside a Rule is coherent precisely because they can't freely break fundamentals — same physics, different OS.) Fuel = transition; price = coherence. *(v5: the bounded space is the in-betweener's **Void** — "their little pocket they make where you play the rule," t128; the Void is the space around the in-betweener, which it moves to where it wants, and **Chain** drags a victim into it, t130. Mechanics: `06_EXTERNAL_POWERS.md`.)*
   - [NEW v5-wk] **Alien and separate.** In-betweeners stay alien and separate; they are the Qu-like **remakers** (wk W37).
   - [NEW v5-jul] **Outside the event chain.** "The in between exists completely outside this event chain. We will have to put serious work into eventually defining why and how thats true" (jul23 t100). 🌊 The why/how is open (and see the author's "outside time and space," phys t162, against "between the worlds" above — CONFLICT).
   - [NEW v5-jul] ⚖️ **The Rule's mechanics are an adjustable foundation.** The rule-beast kit (Phase-step, Unfixing, the Hold, **Cascade**, Afflicted/Victor) was formalized from the author's general descriptions — "they sound good and can always be adjusted later for scenes" (jul08 t365; retag logged at jul08 t370). The core of this law (an ancient lineage that pre-dates the One, runs the Rule, obeys physics) stays 🔒; the named mechanics, Cascade included, are ⚖️ FLEXIBLE.

18. 🔒 **SPIRIT = active Remnant magic — one undivided system (rewritten in the magic rework; the "two directions / Body-vs-Spirit split" is RETIRED).** Spirit is the name for a being consciously using its Remnant to manipulate reality; having Spirit is what separates a conscious being from inert flesh. There are not "two kinds" of magic. The **common case** is Spirit gripping **matter** (described afterward in force/element flavor). The **rare second branch** is Spirit gripping **another being's Remnant** (mind/soul) instead of matter — **soul magic** — which plays by different rules (will-vs-will, two-way, limited by *self-risk* not fatigue) precisely because the target is living consciousness that touches back. 18b. 🔒 **MAGIC IS EXPRESSION, NOT DERIVATION.** Build the person completely first (motives, wounds, history, who taught them, what they'd take to); **then** their magic follows as an expression of *that person*. Flavor (force/element) is assigned last, to describe the output — never to derive the character or be derived from them. **No equation in either direction** (not ability→character, not character→ability, not race→element, not temperament→affinity). The "why this magic" is always the individual's life, never the element's supposed temperament. There are **no force/element "users" or types** — only beings who do magic, with individual learned repertoires, natural inclinations (in kind and scale), and chosen specialties. (This is "silence on the soul," `12_METHOD.md` Law, applied to magic.) *(Re-confirmed v5: "As with all our characters she is just a skilled user" — t612; Lirael is a skilled user, not a "gravity type"; the "Strong-user" label is retired because it "awards it to a special category he belongs to" instead of his mastery — t136.)* *[NEW v5-jul] (The author's general theme: "Characters developing their own unique powers uses our system to its fullest degree... create truly unique flavor for every being. ## The One — origin of CONSCIOUSNESS, not the universe 🔒

The physical universe already existed — matter, energy, and the four forces, running by their own laws with no author. **The One was the birth of *experience* entering that material universe.** Once a singular consciousness whose ultimate desire was to **know what it was not**, it chose to know itself by becoming other — and split. That self-knowing split scattered it into all consciousness: every mind, soul, and spark of experience that has ever been. [NEW v5-cc] ✅ *Theme line:* "The greatest one wished to be everything and that includes things which try to kill each ither" (BANK 11-01; cc R125) — it wished to be everything it was not, including things that try to kill each other. This is not the retired "Everything is the One" doctrine (that 🚫 stands).

🔒 **The One is subject to the forces.** Consciousness arose *within* physics and obeys it. The One is a resident of reality, not its author. Even the divine is inside the physics.

🔒 **All beings are descended from the One; matter is not.** A living being = a physical body (physics) + a fragment of the One (consciousness/mind) inhabiting it. Inanimate matter holds no fragment of the One — it is only physics, and isn't alive. [REV v5-cc] — **unless Remnant is held in it: enchantment is simply Remnant held inside something, in many uses and forms** (cc R099). (was: "[REV v5-wk] — **unless a soul is held in it: enchantment = a soul held in matter.**") Matter can hold Remnant because bodies are inanimate matter made animate; body-like substrate holds best; matter itself does no magic, a held soul in matter does (wk W12; Constitution 0c). (was: the line stood unqualified.) ("Everything is the One" is RETIRED — only *beings* are.)

## The One described LIKE a field ✅ (confirmed framing — t8–9; banked t103)
*Vocabulary for intuition, not a mechanism. Physics is flavor here, never law.*
- The One can be pictured **like a quantum field**: a soul is a **localized resonance / excitation** on the One's field, the way a particle is an excitation on its own field.
- 🔒 **It is a separate field from the physical ones** — "same grammar, different noun." The One's field is consciousness-domain vocabulary only; it is **NOT a physical field**, and it never explains or is explained by physics. The physics/consciousness wall (scope note above; Constitution 0b/0c) is intact: matter still holds no fragment [REV v5-wk] of its own — [REV v5-cc] Remnant can be held in it (enchantment, cc R099) (was: "a soul can be held in it (enchantment)"), and matter itself does no magic (wk W12) (was: "matter still holds no fragment.").
- **Fragment "size" reads as resonance amplitude.** (Pairs with the fragment-size spectrum below — bigger amplitude → more durable body → longer life → fewer generations to the origin.)
- **Conception reads as coalescence:** the diffuse, unclaimed field gathering into a stable resonance (see *How new beings are born*).

## One shatter, not staggered creation 🔒 (reconciled — read before "generations")
All consciousness came into being in the **single** shatter at the beginning. **Every race — elder and latecomer alike — coalesced in that one event; none were "made later."** The old "generations" framing (`07_BEINGS.md`) is recast: the tiers are a spectrum of **fragment-SIZE (→ body-durability → lifespan → generational distance to the origin)**, NOT waves of creation at different times. Bigger fragments got bodies durable enough to persist as individuals across history (dragons, giants, elves) — so the beginning is only a few long lifetimes back, near and vivid, still in living cultural memory. Small fragments got short-lived bodies that cycle through death and reproduction constantly (humans, orcs, the rest) — so thousands of generations stack between them and the origin, and it decays into dim myth they're too consumed by the present to regard. **Same age as peoples; wildly different generational depth.** (This removes the contradiction the old model smuggled in — a second creation event for latecomers, which the single beginningless shatter forbids. No special memory, no forgetting-as-metaphysics, no soul-persistence claim: just long-clock cultures standing near the origin and short-clock cultures far from it.)
- *(v5 scale note — t166/t172:* the **forgetting horizon** in the Law of the Regress below applies to a **being coming apart** (the One, a splitting in-betweener). It is not a claim about peoples: generational depth between races stays cultural/biological, exactly as above.)*

## How new beings are born 🔒 (background bedrock, never on the page)
The FIRST members of every race awoke in the shatter; **every being since — elves included — is BORN.** Mechanism: unclaimed, **diffuse Remnant** — loose fragments of the One drifting unbound in the world — is **drawn together and channeled into the child at conception** (in field vocabulary: the diffuse field coalescing into a stable resonance — t8–9). This is gathering, NOT recycling of the dead and NOT reincarnation (no soul returns; no character is secretly a past self). Reproduction rate scales with **ordinary in-world biology** (body size, gestation, upkeep — the same reason large animals breed rarely and live long), NEVER with Remnant-cost or magical gating: that is why giants and dragons are rare-born and humans/orcs multiply. (🚫 RETIRED: "elves awaken instead of reproducing" — the awakening was the origin-event for ALL races' firsts, not an ongoing elven mechanism; and "new fragments subdivide as beings breed.")
- **Changelings are not an exception to this law (t116, t484, t680).** A changeling is a **born** being — of any race — who became one through soul theft. Changelings are a crime/path, not a race, so they need no birth or reproduction rule of their own. (Detail: `07_BEINGS.md`.)

## Reunion & dissolution — recovered as THEME, not mechanic 🔒
The retired cosmic Light/Dark and Reunion↔Separation poles (scrapped below) return as **lived thematic duality**, carried by peoples and practices rather than by any force with character-rules. **Elves = coherence/reunion BY CONSENT** (the bond; the One's surviving unity — many who choose to be functionally one while remaining themselves). **Changelings = reunion BY CONSUMPTION** (the dark mirror: many souls forced into one vessel, coherence imposed by the strongest; the One's unity *parodied* — `07_BEINGS.md`; v5: changelings are now a crime any born being can commit, not a race — t680). **Humans (and orcs beneath them) = the shatter/dissolution** (fragmentation at its most chaotic — a million separate appetites cohering into nothing). The elf/human conflict *is* the reunion/separation duality, as politics and morality, with **zero magic-breaking machinery.** Per the `04_MAGIC_SUBSTRATE.md` rework, magic may *lean* unifying or sundering **through the character's soul** — never assigned by a cosmic law, always expression-not-derivation. This recovers the poetry of the old poles as flavor while keeping them fully retired as mechanics. [NEW v5-wk] **The duality theme stays as it is; duality = the name versus the act** — not strict cosmic halves (wk W29, W57). **The cosmic axis gets a neutral middle** (wk W29). ⚠️ **OPEN STRUCTURAL DEBT (`11`):** unity now has a light and dark face; symmetry demands dissolution's LIGHT face be found (separation-as-virtue) — undecided.
- [NEW v5-jul] **Consent with a hard edge (jul23 t132–134):** the elves are united, but *"its an authoritarian system. They live under complete subserviance to the king"* (jul23 t132); *"they use reunion at all cost. They have turned their natural draw into the reason they can justify their total controll"* (Patrick, jul23 t134). The consent/consumption axis stands; what changes is that consent's own logic is the weapon (jul23 t135, accepted t136). Physics agrees: *"You can build a grove in the mountains but you are always part of the collective"* (Patrick, phys t598); dissent is crushed by rigid enforcement, never by hell (phys t682–683). Social detail (will-binding through the bond, thought monitoring, harsh internal law): `07_BEINGS.md`.
- **The theme made literal by the Law of the Regress (t166–167):** the One came apart and cannot pull back together. Against that, the elves' bond is re-cohering **by consent**, changelings re-cohere **by force**, humans are the shatter spreading. Same reading as above, now with a cosmic root.
- **The elves' two pocket dimensions (t228, t233):** [REV v5-wk] in-world, the elves are said to have built **heaven** ("a utopia wrapped in light") and its deliberately cruel **sister** (total darkness, drought, famine) — **that is the in-world belief, not the truth** (wk W29; see *The three worlds* below). (was: "the elves built **heaven** … and its deliberately cruel **sister**" as fact.) Patrick: *"If reunion and separation are poles then these 2 dimensions would be the embodiment of the elves reunion and dissolution."* They are pocket dimensions, not universes (terminology above). Pocket dimensions are sealed **between realities**: the bond works inside each, but cannot reach across (t230–231, t600). Full lore in `07_BEINGS.md`.
- **One cosmic pull, stated by Patrick (t460–463) — see** *The pull of reunion* **below.** It is a background force that pressed on the portal-openings. It is not a pole system, gives characters no pole-positions, and assigns no motivation (⚠️ boundary flagged for Patrick — changes file).
